messages.author: ieb
messages.text:
The last update has done a major overhaul on how pop grows. Where before every city had it's own growth & limits. The new system groups all cities and land togheter, and bases pop growth off of current pop. I feel like it would be fair to add a vote for this new system too.

I do have to say I am not exactly happy with either of the systems, as the old one left the ability for very rapid growth and the new one has more or less put a hard cap in place on how much you can practically grow.

messages.author: Silent
messages.text: How is the growth distributed between provinces?  Because my more important one is the slow one for some reason

messages.author: Affairs and Order
messages.text:
<@138867089728339968> growth gets split between your provinces by how much room each one has (cities + land), not by how many people already live there. so if your main province has fewer cities/land than the others it gets the smaller cut. build cities there and it'll pull a bigger share
also if a nation has no rations at all growth is 0, so food first
and yeah small nations are too slow right now, working on a catch-up boost so nations way under their comfort grow faster
